title: A synchronized multimodal neuroimaging dataset to study brain language processing
description: SMN4Lang is a synchronized multimodal neuroimaging dataset for studying brain language processing. It contains fMRI and MEG recordings from the same 12 participants listening to about 6 hours of naturalistic Mandarin Chinese stories. It also includes structural T1/T2, diffusion MRI, resting-state fMRI, and linguistic annotations of the stimuli such as word frequencies, part-of-speech tags, syntactic trees, time-aligned characters and words, and word embeddings.
methods_description: Twelve right-handed native Mandarin speakers completed fMRI (7 visits) and MEG (6 visits) sessions in which they listened to 60 naturalistic story audios of 4-7 minutes each and answered questions after each story. Stimuli were presented with Psychtoolbox-3. MRI data were preprocessed with the HCP minimal preprocessing pipelines. MEG data were processed with tSSS, bad channel exclusion, and ICA-based ocular artifact removal in MNE.
